_about: English display names that replace the Wikidata label on the site (Paul, 2026-11-09: usual name and title case). Drafted with Claude Code on 2026-11-09 from the Parker 2017 supplement-1 name (AKC usage) and the FCI English name; reviewed=false until Paul checks it. The Wikidata label stays in breeds.json as names.wikidataEn.

entries.basis: Casing only. Wikidata label "Basset hound"; Parker and FCI 163: Basset Hound.
Casing only. Wikidata label "Border collie"; Parker and FCI 297: Border Collie.
Wikidata label "Griffon Bruxellois" (FCI 80 name, French). Parker name, AKC name and site id: Brussels Griffon.
doubts: The FCI splits the AKC Brussels Griffon into 80, 81 and 82; the page is attached to 80 (see breed-names.json BRUS).

entries.basis: Wikidata label "St. Bernard". Parker name and site id: Saint Bernard (FCI 61 writes "St. Bernhardshund" / "St. Bernard").
Wikidata label "English Mastiff". FCI 264 and site id: Mastiff; Parker: English Mastiff.
doubts: "Mastiff" alone also names a breed type; Parker and Wikidata say English Mastiff.

entries.basis: The Parker dogs are Pomeranians (POM), which the FCI files under 97 German Spitz (size Zwergspitz / Pomeranian). Wikidata label: German Spitz.
doubts: Alternative: keep "German Spitz" and name the Pomeranian in the page text only.
